# AIFeed.run AI News

> The AI news that matters. Big AI stories in plain English, with the source on every one.

AIFeed.run (display name: AIFeed.run AI News) publishes short, source-linked AI news on aifeed.run, Instagram @aifeed.run, Facebook, and LinkedIn. Stories are selected and written by AI systems. We do not claim human editors rewrite the news. A free weekly newsletter is available at https://aifeed.run/subscribe/.

## Site
- Home: https://aifeed.run/
- About: https://aifeed.run/about/
- FAQ: https://aifeed.run/faq/
- Subscribe: https://aifeed.run/subscribe/
- RSS: https://aifeed.run/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://aifeed.run/sitemap.xml
- All stories: https://aifeed.run/news/

## Topics
- [Industry](https://aifeed.run/news/topics/industry/): Big Tech moves, AI companies, deals, jobs and the business of artificial intelligence.
- [Business](https://aifeed.run/news/topics/business/): How AI is changing companies, markets, money and work.
- [Safety](https://aifeed.run/news/topics/safety/): AI safety, risks, misuse, deepfakes and what can go wrong with AI systems.
- [Research](https://aifeed.run/news/topics/research/): New AI research, studies, benchmarks and scientific breakthroughs.
- [Policy](https://aifeed.run/news/topics/policy/): AI laws, regulation, government action and court cases.
- [Tools](https://aifeed.run/news/topics/tools/): AI tools and apps you can use, and what they do.
- [Models](https://aifeed.run/news/topics/models/): New AI models from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Meta and others, and how they compare.
- [Products](https://aifeed.run/news/topics/products/): AI product launches, devices and features from the biggest tech companies.
- [Hardware](https://aifeed.run/news/topics/hardware/): AI chips, Nvidia, GPUs, devices and the hardware behind AI.
- [Infrastructure](https://aifeed.run/news/topics/infrastructure/): Data centers, compute, energy and the infrastructure powering AI.
- [Health](https://aifeed.run/news/topics/health/): AI in medicine, healthcare and biology.
- [Security](https://aifeed.run/news/topics/security/): AI and cybersecurity: attacks, breaches, defenses and privacy.
